create_op_schema: create an OpSchema to describe operator input schemas with DTensorSpecs for sharding propagation
build_placement_strategy: build a PlacementStrategy describing acceptable sharding placements for operator inputs and outputs
test_is_inplace_op: test whether an OpOverload is an inplace variant by checking its schema name suffix
summarize_op_strategy: summarize an OpStrategy containing a list of placement strategies with mesh shape and shard counts
run_output_sharding: run sharding propagation rules and capture OutputSharding results with suggestions on failure
